decisions.reason: Selecting beige as the primary color does not change the independently specified DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The color selection does not change the machine name or retained wording requirements.
The beige color decision does not affect bowl capacity or form, and the source message's separate bowl-size clause is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
Changing the primary color does not alter the spout location, orientation, geometry, or pouring goal.
The system-layout and CAD deliverable remains valid unchanged; the separate color Requirement supplies the palette without requiring another CAD-state attribute.
The exterior color selection has no necessary effect on the electrical wiring-plan deliverable.
The beige color decision does not change the required mixing quality, foam consistency, or mixing priority.
The primary color selection does not alter the splash-control behavior.
The color decision does not change the valve mechanism, closed-valve behavior, or controlled flow requirement.
The exterior color selection does not affect plumbing seals or liquid-containment requirements.
The color decision does not change the fluid-path cleaning requirement or cleaning method.
